game.title: Bedroom Roots
game.design: Jamaican-inspired red/gold/green textiles, flag art, stereo, tam and locs
game.character_animation: Six rigid voxel mesh parts with shoulder/hip pivots, walking swings and care gestures
game.movement: WASD/arrows or click-to-walk; grid pathfinding and body collision
game.interaction: E requires proximity; care buttons queue walking and perform once on arrival

checks.release_game_loop: passed; far E guard, walking to pot, starter crop through harvest, water animation, XP level2, pot upgrade, progress roundtrip, pause guard
checks.voxel_sources: Exact VOX geometry/palette roundtrip; zero room-part overlaps, exact GLB world bounds, connected avatar and nonoverlapping rigid pieces; starter props checked at all four growth stages

performance.scenario: three mature plants, upgraded light rack and fan
performance.measurement: actual monotonic wall-clock interval between process frames; source render objects/triangles include shadow and UI passes
performance.scope: Measured on this laptop, not a guarantee for other devices.

limitations: No offline growth, campaign, quests or additional rooms.
Character animation uses six rigid voxel parts rather than a skinned armature.
Meshes depict true occupied cubes; runtime block editing/destruction is not implemented.
